error_message: SMG harness run se25 never left the main menu (0 captures, 7 minutes): qconsole `ERROR: coop_mod/player_Legs.st: Unknown condition 'COOP_TURRET_LOW' on line 1445`
root_cause: The 11:02 deploy put the integrated build's paks in the GOG folder the private harness reads, but the harness copy still had its game.dll of 2026-10-12 (689d0db1): the listen server dies at map load on a state-file condition the old DLL does not know. The rifle lane hit the same on rb57 (its README says so); this lane's handover did not carry it over.
fix: game.dll and games/game_install_orig.dll of G:/mohaa-adsanim3 = the released 6b515fbf, copied FROM G:/mohaa-gl2 (nothing written there); the old one kept as games/game_install_orig_until_20261013_689d0db1.dll. Run id se25 is spent. After any deploy: compare the harness game.dll md5 with G:/mohaa-gl2/game.dll before the first run.

error_message: SMG lane test overlay would have hidden the integrated baseline: the lane's fps_anims_smg.txt replaces the live file whole, so the MP40 family's shipped per-weapon rows (coopr_mp40_*) vanish and the Grease Guns / Silenced PPS-43 see the LANE's repointed generic mp40_* rows instead of the released ones
root_cause: mkov_smg.py packs every file under smg/assets. After the integration shipped the MP40 family as per-weapon rows and put the generic mp40_* rows back to released, the lane file (generic rows repointed, frozen for the integrator) is no longer the baseline a new gun has to be built on; the staged viewmodel/mp40/mp40_reload_ads.skc also replaces the released clip of the same name.
fix: mkov_smg.py --integ: the overlay's row file = the LIVE file + every lane row except the generic mp40_* ones (changed clip in place, new rows appended); mp40/mp40_reload_ads.skc left out. Use --integ for every run from se26 on. New guns get rows coopr_<weapon NAME key>_<row> only.

error_message: Thompson (1928 Tommy): the first split put `Skin5` on the new bolt bone - a plate on the receiver's LEFT wall (knob reported at y -1.53, z -2.51), not the actuator knob
root_cause: The surface was picked from a listing of four guns printed with `tail -2` each: the line `Skin5 146 verts min [-1.65 -1.12 -5.48]` belonged to the M1928 mesh (coop_tommy28), not to coop_tommy1928d. On the 1928 Tommy the knob is 41 vertices of the big surface Skin3.
fix: OWN `split_box` = (surface, box in the gun frame): the 41 vertices of Skin3 above the receiver top (x -2.62 .. -1.85, top z -5.15) go onto coop_bolt; the wrong build was removed before anything used it. Read a mesh's own knobfind / survey line before naming a surface; never a multi-gun tail.

error_message: split_bone.py: `selected verts hang on several bones {0, 1} - pick a cleaner set` (Thompson 1928 Tommy knob)
root_cause: The pack mesh hangs neighbouring vertices of one part on `origin` and on `tommy gun new` (single weights; neither bone moves in any clip). split_bone only re-points the bone index, which is right for one parent only.
fix: smggun.unify_parents: the minority's weight records are rewritten in place onto the majority bone, offset and normal carried over by the two bones' rest transforms (rest place asserted to 1e-4 u), then the split runs. Bytes, counts and order unchanged.

error_message: Top-knob Thompson (M1928), first offline bake: the left hand came to the knob OPEN - straight splayed fingers on the approach, a flat hand over the receiver - and its knuckles touched the centre box's lower-left corner on the way up
root_cause: The finger pose was the fore-grip grip mixed toward the retail cocking frame's open hand, blended in from the magazine hold's spread fingers; the approach key stood 1.4 u ABOVE the hook place.
fix: flex_pose: the fore-grip's own grip closed further (index 8/22/18 deg, the others 28/44/30) as the borrowed-fingers key for every frame the hand is off the magazine; a via key down-left of the magazine (closing there); approach from the LEFT at knob height (-0.4, -2.2, -0.5). Offline it is a closed hand under the box in every frame. IN THE ENGINE (se28, contact sheet) the hand still reads partly open - not settled, see the handover.

error_message: Thompson (1928 Tommy) offline: 4.5 % of the centre box at clip f26-27 (rounds left and emptied) - the drum's upper edge rises into the box as the drum is drawn out
root_cause: The side-magazine drag reaction (smg_side_drag, roll 78 x magk 1.3) cants the gun about the sight line; this gun's drum is a 9.7 u disc whose top stands 38 px under the box in the aim, so a 7 deg cant lifts its left half into the box. The prop itself is seated exactly (propseat.py: 0.00 u at f22 / f24 / f58 / f60).
fix: magk 0.45 for the 1928 Tommy (offline 1.5 %), 0.7 for the 50rd (0.5 %). NOT run in the engine (budget stop).

error_message: Drum Thompsons: with an EMPTIED gun cocked first (f10-16) the reload sound's handle clacks would be heard at f57-65, 1.5 s after the pull; the stick-magazine out / in sounds (f10-13, f45-49) are also 0.5 s off the drum change the audit timed (out f24-30, in f54-58)
root_cause: thompson50.tik and thompsonsmg_tommy1928d.tik play the stick Thompson's alias thompson_snd_reload over their own, differently timed reload.
fix: drumsound.py lays the same recording out again in pieces (handle at f8.5, out at f24.5, in at f46; 6 ms fades): coop_thompson_snd_reload_drum (EMPTY rows) and ..._drum_loaded (`reload`, no handle); the two staged tiks' client blocks point at them. Must be re-run after smggun.py for these two guns. NOT listened to, not run in the engine.

error_message: Thompson 50rd, released hip reload with rounds left: the left hand goes over the top and pulls the actuator knob at f12-15 - on an open-bolt gun whose knob is already back
root_cause: The reload audit's clip tommydrum_reload.skc cocks first in every reload (the pack's gun clip ran the bolt forward at the reload's start: the closed-bolt story). With the open-bolt gun clips of this lane the knob rests back when rounds are left.
fix: Both drum guns get BOTH hip clips from the lane's own choreography on the hip pose (hip_proc, as the MP18): rounds left without the pull, emptied with it first; the hip rounds-left rows coopr_thompson_50rd_reload / coopr_thompson_1928_tommy_reload are repointed in anims_shared.txt (rows_extra `shared`). Staged, NOT run in the engine.
